title: SWF: DoInitAction tag (tag 59) for symbol initialization
description: Test that symbols with exportForActionScript=true emit DoInitAction (tag 59) after DefineSprite. DoInitAction body should contain ActionScript bytecode for the symbol's init script (class registration). Verify: (1) tag 59 appears in SWF, (2) it references the correct sprite character ID (SI16 field), (3) the body contains AVM1 opcodes for class setup.
